concerns.text: Task T025c (Bootstrap Resampling) is marked as incomplete [ ], but Task T026 (Robustness Check Variable) and T026b (Robustness Check Tau) explicitly depend on the output of T025c (`water_mixing_ratio_samples.npy` and bootstrap tau values). A consumer task (T026/T026b) cannot execute before its producer (T025c) is implemented. This creates a hard ordering violation where the pipeline logic is broken.

Task T027 (Tobit Regression) depends on T020 (Save Retrieval Results), but T020 is marked as incomplete [ ]. Furthermore, T030a (Output Correlation Stats) depends on T025b and T025c, while T030b (Output Regression Stats) depends on T027. The chain T020 -> T027 -> T030b is broken because the producer (T020) is not implemented, preventing the consumer (T027) from running.

Task T031 (Power Analysis) depends on T030a, which in turn depends on T025c (Bootstrap). Since T025c is incomplete, T031 cannot be executed. The dependency chain for the power analysis is broken at the bootstrap generation step.

Task T049 (Quantitative Evidence Summary) depends on T045, T046, T047, T034, and T026. T045 (Spectral Resolution Reporting) and T047 (Noise Stability Analysis) are marked as incomplete [ ]. T026 is also incomplete. A summary task (T049) cannot be executed if its constituent data-generating tasks are not implemented.

Task T053 (Create Pipeline Orchestrator) depends on T012, T020, and T027. T020 and T027 are marked as incomplete [ ]. The orchestrator cannot be finalized or tested if the core retrieval and analysis modules it orchestrates are not implemented.

Task T012 (Save Metadata) is marked as incomplete [ ], but Task T013a (Count) and T013b (Report Count) depend on it. While T013a/b are marked [X], they cannot logically run if T012 is not implemented. The status markers [X] on consumers vs [ ] on producers are inconsistent with the dependency flow.
